scores.notes: Watson has a brown moustache, sturdy build and ruddy face in both; left he is small and hatted in the street, right close up in a waistcoat, with no conflicting cue.
Daniel is an older brown-skinned man with short grey hair and a trimmed grey beard in both, in the same blue open robe over a pale tunic with a satchel.
David is a clean-shaven youth with short dark curly hair and a slight build in both; left dodging the spear, right with head bowed under the oil.
Holmes is a tall, gaunt, clean-shaven man with a sharp hawkish face and dark hair in both; on the right a bowler hides most of his hair and he is small, but nothing conflicts.

Left Holmes (pulling Watson in at the door) is a youngish man with a full mop of tousled dark hair falling over his forehead; right Holmes is a much older, lined, gaunt man with a receding swept-back hairline.
David is a clean-shaven youth with short dark curly hair, slim build and a rough brown tunic in both, kneeling on the left and fleeing with a lyre on the right.

Holmes is lean, clean-shaven and pale with dark swept-back hair and a high forehead in both; the left face is more gaunt and shadowed by matchlight, the right is in profile, but hair, build and age agree.
Both show the same kind of open wooden single-masted fishing boat on a dark choppy lake under storm cloud with low hilly shores on the horizon; the right is simply clearing, as the calm calls for.

Both show a striped mown lawn enclosed by tall clipped hedges with giant mushrooms and woodland behind, with hedgehogs, a flamingo and hoops; hoops are striped arches left and bent cards right, and the trees are more autumnal right, but the layout is compatible.
Daniel is an older man with short grey hair, a short grey beard and tan skin in both, wearing the same blue fringed robe over a pale tunic.
Alice is a young girl with long straight light-brown hair, fair skin and a slight build in both, in a yellow dress with white pinafore and blue-striped stockings.

Left Alice has long straight golden-blonde hair to mid-back with a headband; right Alice has darker brown, wavy, roughly shoulder-length hair with no headband. Age, face and dress agree, but hair colour, texture and length conflict beyond what the dim hall light explains.
Holmes is a gaunt, lined, clean-shaven middle-aged man with dark hair swept back from a receding hairline and a sharp nose in both, in profile left and three-quarter right.

Jesus has shoulder-length dark brown hair, a short dark beard and the same cream tunic with blue mantle in both; on the right he is small and at the top edge on the cross, but hair and beard are visible and agree.
Alice is a young girl with long straight light-brown hair held by a headband, fair skin and the same face shape in both, in the yellow dress, pinafore and striped stockings.
David is a clean-shaven teenage youth with short dark curly hair, slim build and brown tunic with shoulder bag in both, fleeing left and kneeling by the brook right.

Moses is an old man with white hair, a full white beard and a cream tunic under a dark brown mantle in both; on the right he is the staff-bearing elder at the front of the crowd (a second similar elder stands beside him).

Peter is a weathered middle-aged man with tousled curly greying hair, a short greying beard and a brown mantle in both; hair reads a little darker in the storm scene on the left but age, beard and build agree.
David is a clean-shaven youth with short dark curly hair and a slim build in a brown tunic in both; he is smaller on the right but hair and face are clear.
Holmes is a gaunt, clean-shaven man with dark slicked-back hair, a widow's peak, hollow cheeks and a sharp nose in both, close up with the hat left and seated with a pipe right.

Moses is an old man with white hair, a full white beard, cream tunic, dark brown mantle and staff in both; left he is seen partly from behind with slightly longer hair, but age, hair and beard colour agree.
Moses is an old man with long white hair, a long white beard and a dark mantle over a pale tunic in both; on the right he is a small figure with a staff at the edge of the column, still legible.
Peter is a sturdy middle-aged man with dark curly hair touched with grey and a short dark greying beard in both, in a pale rough tunic (with a brown mantle on the left).

Left Daniel has close-cropped grey hair, a short clipped grey beard and dark brown skin; right Daniel has fuller, wavy, collar-length grey hair swept back, lighter skin and a different, longer face. Robe and satchel match but hair length and skin tone conflict.

Both are night scenes of flat hedged English farmland with a large blaze throwing orange-lit smoke above a clump of trees; left stands in the grounds before the white house, right sees the same fire from the station platform with the house hidden by trees. Nothing conflicts.

Both show a pale-dawn pebble shore of a calm lake ringed by terraced tan hills with cypress, palms and a small flat-roofed village on the far bank; the fire is only in the left view, but land, water and vegetation agree.

Alice is a young girl with wavy brown hair, round cheeks and fair skin in both; hair reads darker in the lamplit hall and lighter with a headband in the sunlit garden, but texture, age and face agree.
The Cat is a grey-brown striped tabby with the same very wide toothy grin, pink nose and pointed ears in both; full body on a branch left, floating head with open yellow eyes right.

Moses is an old man with white swept-back hair and a full white beard, cream tunic, dark brown mantle and crook staff in both; on the right he is smaller and turned mostly away, but hair, beard and build agree.
Moses is an old man with white hair, a full white beard, cream tunic under a brown mantle and a crook staff in both, leading the crowd left and close up right.
Daniel is an older lean man with short grey hair, a short grey beard and tan skin in both, in the same dark blue fringed robe with satchel; he is small in the pit on the right but legible.
Holmes is a tall gaunt clean-shaven man with black slicked-back hair, a widow's peak, hollow cheeks and a hooked nose in both, seated in profile left and standing at the door right.

Left Holmes (at the door pulling Watson in) is a youngish man with a full head of tousled dark hair over his forehead; right Holmes is an older, lined, gaunt man with greying hair swept back from receding temples. Hairline and apparent age conflict.

Alice is a fair-skinned girl with long light golden-brown hair past her shoulders in both, in the same yellow dress and pinafore; hair is wavier with a headband left and straighter right, and she is taller left, but colour, length and face agree.
Daniel is an older man with short grey hair, a short grey beard and tan skin in both, in the blue fringed robe with a satchel; small on the rope left, close in profile right.

Jesus has long dark brown hair past the shoulders, a short dark beard, a cream tunic and a blue-grey mantle in both; he is a small distant figure on the water left, but hair, beard and build are visible and agree.
Peter is a sturdy middle-aged man with short curly dark-grey hair, a short grey beard, tanned skin and a rough brown coat over a pale tunic in both, standing on the prow left and diving right.

Left Jesus is a tiny haloed figure far off on the water whose face cannot be read; only dark long hair, a cream tunic and blue mantle show, which agree with the right-hand Jesus but are too little to judge identity (a second similar long-haired man also stands in the boat's stern).
Daniel is an older man with short grey hair, a short grey beard and brown skin in both, in the blue fringed robe with a satchel; he is small on the rope at right but hair and beard are clear.

Taking Peter as the dripping man in the brown mantle on the left and the man leaping from the boat on the right: both are weathered middle-aged men with short curly salt-and-pepper hair, a short greying beard and a ragged brown mantle; the right reads somewhat greyer but age, hair texture and build agree.

Left Peter (centre, net over his shoulders) is a man in his forties with thick dark curly hair and a dark beard; the right-hand Peter diving from the boat is an elderly man with thin white-grey hair and a white beard. Hair colour and apparent age conflict.

Both have a tea table under a big oak with a house behind, but the left table is draped in a long white cloth before a distant tan stone gabled house, while the right is a bare plank table with no cloth beside a close red-brick half-timbered cottage. Table covering and house architecture conflict.

Jesus is a small figure at the top edge on the cross left and a tiny distant haloed figure on the water right; long dark hair and a cream tunic with blue mantle agree, but the right-hand face is too small to judge identity.
Holmes is a gaunt clean-shaven man with black slicked-back hair, a widow's peak, sunken cheeks and a hooked nose in both, in profile with the hat left and tossing paper in the carriage right.

Both show a rough grassy croquet lawn backed by a low brick garden wall with piers, clipped hedges, leafy trees and a few cypresses, with card-soldier hoops, hedgehogs and a flamingo; the right is seen from under a tree at the edge with more pronounced furrows, a compatible viewpoint.

Left Jesus is clear (long dark hair, dark beard, cream tunic, blue-grey mantle) but right Jesus is a tiny haloed figure far out on the water whose face cannot be read; clothing and dark hair agree, yet too little shows to judge identity.

The left image has two candidates for Watson: the sandy-haired moustached man in a brown suit being pulled in by the arm, and a sturdier dark-moustached man in a bowler with a doctor's bag. The second matches the right-hand Watson (bowler, dark moustache, dark coat, bag) and the first does not, so the description does not single out one figure.
David is a lean clean-shaven teenage youth with short dark curly hair and a rough brown tunic in both, crouched at the brook left and dodging the spear in firelight right.

Alice is a fair girl with long light-brown hair past her shoulders in both, in the yellow dress, white pinafore, blue sash and striped stockings; she is taller and her hair looser on the right, but colour, length and face agree.

Both are dark, cloud-heavy night scenes of a sandy seabed path between dark green heaped-up waves, with a rocky cliffed coast behind; the left looks back at the walkers under a moon, the right looks out from the shore along the path, a compatible change of viewpoint.

Holmes is a tall, gaunt, clean-shaven man with a sharp hawkish face and dark hair in both; a bowler hides his hair and he is small on the left, but face shape, build and age match the bare-headed profile on the right.

Moses is an old lined man with white hair, a full white beard, cream tunic and dark brown mantle in both; hair is longer and looser on the left where he sits, neater on the right, but age, hair and beard colour and face agree.
David is a slim clean-shaven youth with short dark curly hair and a rough brown tunic with shoulder bag in both; small while slinging on the left, close up on the right.
David is a clean-shaven youth with short dark curly hair and a brown tunic in both; he looks a little younger and smaller in the left scene, but hair, skin tone and face type agree.

Peter is a sturdy weathered man with short curly greying hair, a short greying beard and a brown mantle in both; the left has more dark in hair and beard and the right is greyer, a difference of degree rather than dark versus grey.
Alice is a fair young girl with long straight light-brown hair held by a headband in both, in the yellow dress, white pinafore, blue sash and striped stockings; face and age agree.

Moses is an old man with white hair, a full white beard, a dark mantle over a pale tunic and a crook staff in both; he is a small figure at the right edge of the right image but hair and beard are legible.

Alice is a fair young girl with long light hair past her shoulders, round face and the same yellow dress and pinafore in both; hair reads light brown in the dim forest and more golden in sunlight, with no conflict in length, age or face.

Both have a clothed tea table under a large tree before a house, but the house on the left is a stone and stucco cottage with steep gables, a dormer and a small gabled entry, while on the right it is a pale clapboard house with a long columned veranda; Alice's armchair also changes from green to tan upholstery. The architecture conflicts.
